verdict.rationale: The evidence points toward attribution: flow performance reports via the MCP server (docs-33), built-in reports (docs-19), and conversion event tracking through custom events and the SDKs (docs-30, docs-32). The API also supports pulling data for marketing performance analysis (docs-18). However, nothing explicitly documents attributing signups or revenue to individual emails or flows beyond engagement metrics, and the 63x ROI figure is marketing copy rather than a feature description. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of revenue/conversion attribution per campaign and flow, attribution window/model details, signup attribution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
